newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to sell Custravalca for $60 mln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to sell Custravalca for $60 mln.

text.p: Venezuela's state Deposits Guarantee Fund FOGADE said Monday it would auction security systems and delivery holding company Custravalca on Dec 11 for a minimum price of $60 million.
The 99.92 percent stake on offer is owned by FOGADE (74.92 percent), Brink's Security International, INC (15 percent) and Banco Consolidado (10 percent), Fogade said in a release.
Custravalca groups together the companies Servicio Pan Americano de Proteccion CA y Blindados Filiales, Domesa, Radio Contacto CA and Grapho Formas CA.
FOGADE said five foreign companies and two Venezuelan companies had shown interest in the sale.
